name: config_get
description: Read a key from a config file (.json/.yaml/.toml/.ini/.env) without any dependency

path.description: config file (max 2 MB); omitted or missing = the usual names at the root (config.*, settings.*, pyproject.toml, package.json, .env)

key.description: dotted path like a.b.c or section.key or items[0]; empty = whole document

query.description: free text naming the key (and maybe the file); the key is matched against the file's real paths
